description: Create a hosted okgate proxy in front of an MCP server. Returns the proxy id, the per-customer MCP URL and the proxy key (shown once). Point your agent's MCP client at the URL with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Requires an account key.

mode.description: dry-run records what the policy would have blocked and lets every call through; enforce actually blocks. Start in dry-run.

upstreamName.description: name used to namespace tools when you add more upstreams later

upstreamUrl.description: Streamable HTTP URL of the MCP server to protect

name: okgate_create_proxy
